summary: The owner's Breach Ring: any 3 of the 4 top-tier attack flats as prefixes, start compared; creator side = the prefix part of Keyson's route (bought fractured flat, Chaos for the second, desecration + Omen of Light for the third).

steps: Buy an item level 82+ ring with a FRACTURED top-tier attack flat (cold, fire or lightning); Keyson paid 60-70 div for his Gold Ring base.
Chaos Orb until a second top-tier elemental attack flat lands: about 400 on average, his own run took about 600.

Keyson's suffix work (placeholder slam, Essence of the Breach, catalysed Perfect Exalt slams, Reaver quality, whittles) is out of scope: this request has no suffix targets, so its materials are not counted.

Desecrate the last prefix with a collarbone; on a miss, Omen of Light + Orb of Annulment and desecrate again until a top-tier flat (he says 15 tries should be enough, under 10 when rarity also counts; bone type unstated, preserved assumed).
Keyson's whole-ring total (300-400 div, suffixes included) is not this request's scope, so statedTotalDiv is left null.

sources.ref: 2026-10-06 trade check of a 3x top-tier attack flat Breach Ring (~380 div); the request mirrors the owner's planner input (prefix pool any 3 of 4 at the top tier, start compared)
